_meta.notes: DRAFT — NOT WIRED. Roster only. The Texas House publishes NO per-member press releases. All 150 members were probed live on 2026-07-25: the only per-member content surfaces are /members/{code}/media and /members/{code}/newsletters. /media returned an explicit 'No Media at this time.' for 141 of 150 members; the 6 members with any item at all hold scholarship applications, redistricting plan PDFs and a holiday-ornament album, not press releases. /newsletters holds 522 constituent e-newsletter PDFs across 46 members, which GOALS.md places out of scope. There is also no chamber-wide press-release section: house.texas.gov/videos/press is a press-conference VIDEO archive, and the Speaker's page carries committee proclamation PDFs rather than releases. Every row therefore has collection_method: null and expect_empty: true. Do not register this file in pipeline/lib/seeds.py without an explicit scope decision. party is null for all 150 rows because house.texas.gov does not publish party affiliation anywhere on the member pages or the roster; it was left unset rather than sourced from a third party. member_code is the Texas 'member bill code' used in the URL path and in capitol.texas.gov report links; district is the House district number.
